name: Arifureta Hibi.
source:
Today, like always, Kamisako Mitsuki barely makes it in time for class.
There's a boy Mitsuki likes. His name is Nakaarai Makoto.
Even more so, she has a crush on him.
This is the story of their mundane days.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/19299]Freem![/url]]
translation:
今天，和往常一样，神佐子美月勉强能及时上课。
三希有喜欢的男孩子。他的名字叫中新井诚。
更何况，她还迷恋着他。
这就是他们平凡日子的故事。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/19299]Freem![/url]]
